//: Import firewall for the markdown engine. Extends the app config but clears `paths`, so any surviving '@/...' import fails module resolution with a hard tsc error — stronger than an eslint rule, because it cannot be disabled by a comment and it runs before the linter. Deliberately NOT named tsconfig.json: the engine already ships its own tsconfig.json for its standalone build (referenced by its package.json, Makefile and Dockerfile) and that file must stay untouched.
